newsitem.title: HUNGARY: KWASNIEWSKI ARRIVES IN HUNGARY ON TWO-DAY VISIT.
newsitem.headline: KWASNIEWSKI ARRIVES IN HUNGARY ON TWO-DAY VISIT.

text.p: Polish President Aleksander Kwasniewski arrived in Hungary on Monday on a two-day official visit.

Talks with Hungary's government leaders are expected to focus on economic developent within the regional grouping, the Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA), but will also take in the two countries' efforts to join the European Union and NATO.

Kwasniewski is also scheduled to meet Hungary's Catholic Cardinal Laszlo Paskai, open an Polish art exhibition and deliver a lecture in English to the Hungarian Foreign Affairs Institute at Budapest's Eotvos Lorand University.
